items.title: Munity Beta is live
items.summary: Server is up and open for testing. All progress wipes before full launch.

items.title: Scurrius and Yama reworks
items.summary: Scurrius is now a proper 3-phase fight. Yama glyphs swap cleanly, Judge bug fixed. Yama takes +20% from demonbane and +50% from water spells.

items.title: Combat, specs and interfaces
items.summary: Tonalztics Division special added. Purging Staff demonbane 20% to 40% and stacks with Mark of Darkness. Blue Moon Frost Storm and Weapon Freeze reworked.

items.title: Moons of Peril and Hueycoatl
items.summary: New bosses: Blood Moon, Blue Moon, Eclipse Moon, The Hueycoatl. New gear: Blue Moon Spear, Soulflame Horn, Oathplate set, Sunlight Crossbow.
